blockWrapper: div.<name>-wrapper; section gains .<name>-container; block gets .block + data-block-name
sectionMetadata: server-side (pipeline renders section-metadata style → classes); aem.js decorateSections does not read section-metadata
chrome: loadHeader/loadFooter build header/footer blocks in loadLazy; fragments /nav and /footer via blocks/fragment loadFragment (.plain.html)
fonts: styles/fonts.css loaded by loadFonts() (eager on desktop ≥900px or session flag, always in loadLazy)
